anomalies.description: Following the vehicle impact, the crowd erupts into chaotic movement: people flee, some fall or are knocked down, and others appear to converge or react violently; the scene shows sustained collective unrest and disorder consistent with riot conditions.
A dark sedan accelerates toward a crowd of protesters on a narrow street, then makes contact with individuals near the center of the road, causing people to scatter and fall.

A bicycle wheel and part of a vehicle are visible at the top-left in frame f0, with motion blur and scattered debris on pavement; combined with the news banner 'CAR RUNS INTO CROWD', this supports a vehicle striking pedestrians or objects at the start of the clip.

A large crowd of people is seen running and scattering in panic on a street, consistent with a violent disruption during a protest; the chaotic movement, fallen individuals (e.g., frame f6), and presence of motorcycles and debris suggest collective violent unrest.

In frames f13–f15, a person is seen lying motionless on the pavement while others run past; one individual appears to step over or near the prone person without assistance, suggesting potential neglect or exploitation of a helpless victim in the chaos.
A vehicle (appearing as a dark sedan) rapidly enters the frame from the left and collides with pedestrians in the street, causing people to be struck and thrown.

Following the vehicle impact, a chaotic crowd reaction ensues: people scatter, fall, and engage in urgent physical movement; some individuals appear to confront or assist others amid the disorder, consistent with violent unrest triggered by the crash.

In frames f2–f4, two individuals near the center (one in pink head covering, one in blue shirt) are engaged in close physical contact that appears mutual and aggressive—grappling and pushing—amid the chaos after the car impact.

A person on a motorcycle is seen lying on the ground while another individual stands over them in a posture suggesting assault; the context of the surrounding crowd and subsequent car incident supports interpretation as targeted violence during unrest.

A dark-colored sedan accelerates into a crowd of pedestrians on a pedestrian plaza, striking multiple people and causing them to be thrown to the ground; the car comes to rest with visible front-end damage.
A dark-colored sedan is seen striking a person on the ground in a pedestrian plaza; the car's front end is heavily damaged and the person is under or immediately beside the vehicle.
